Filings

A filing is what goes to an authority: in Germany the advance VAT return (de-ustva) and the Anlage EÜR (de-euer). spezado derives it from the books, records it, and submits it through an adapter – a service of its own per country that talks to the authority, after librotenado 0007. spezado itself never talks to ELSTER.

OPEN: there is no adapter for ELSTER yet. It needs ERiC, the library of the German tax administration, which is handed out to registered developers only; falkOSS registers once it is founded. Until then filings are prepared and recorded, and can be tried with any adapter that follows librotenado 0007.

Preparing

A filing is prepared from a report and its period: its fields as the books give them now, and the state of the books they were derived from. It is never changed afterwards.

  • Asked again while nothing changed, spezado returns the same filing.
  • When the books change so that the fields would differ – a booking in the period, a reversal –, the filing is outdated: it is not submitted; prepare it again.
  • A filing prepared after one was submitted or accepted is a correction of it (in German a berichtigte Voranmeldung).
  • A VAT return with nothing to report is a filing too.

Submitting

The adapter is set per country: its address – https://…, or http://127.0.0.1:… on this device – and the token spezado authenticates itself with. The token goes into the key store of the system where there is one.

A test submission goes to the adapter marked as a test, which the authority does not process; nothing is recorded in the books. A real one moves the filing on: submitted, then accepted or rejected as the authority answers. What it returns – a protocol of the transfer, a notice – becomes a document of the books, with its original. A rejected filing is submitted again, or corrected.

  Terminal Web app Command line
prepare p on a report’s figures Prepare as a filing on a report spezado filing prepare de-ustva --from … --to …
list the filings after the reports Filings under the reports spezado filing
submit ↵ on a filing: a test or for real Submit as a test, Submit spezado filing submit <id> [--test]
ask where it stands ↵ on a submitted filing Ask where it stands spezado filing refresh <id>
set the adapter – Filings, change SPEZADO_ADAPTER_TOKEN=… spezado adapter DE <url>
